messages.content_text: Ops walked me through the host today. We need to lock the production serving setup for the dashboard before tonight.

Understood. The reverse proxy (nginx) on that host fronts the app, so the app itself should never listen on a public interface — it must bind to 127.0.0.1 only and let the proxy handle the outside world.
Not 8080 — the metrics sidecar already owns 8080 on that host, which is why the staging attempt failed to start last week. Use port 4370 for the app.
TLS terminates at the nginx proxy, so the app must serve plain HTTP: keep tls OFF in the app config. If you enable tls in the app too you get a double-termination loop and the health checks die.
Agreed. DECISION: ledger-web production serves on 127.0.0.1:4370, plain HTTP, TLS off in the app — the proxy terminates TLS. I'll put it in the deployment ticket too.
